ns2:course.label: Elementary Spoken Mandarin I
ns2:course.description: For non-majors who want to develop a basic competence in spoken Mandarin Chinese. Emphasizes the development of pronunciation, vocabulary and grammar skills with a concurrent emphasis on mastery of Pinyin phonetic orthography. Credit is not given for both this course and CHIN 201 or CHIN 202.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both this course and CHIN 201 or CHIN 202.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Senior or Graduate class standing.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: CHIN 221 is for those who have no background in Mandarin and teaches only spoken Mandarin and no Chinese Character Writing. Completion of the CHIN 221-CHIN 222 sequence enables students to take CHIN 241.
